title: Shadow of the Ancestor
next_chapter_hook: Deep within the altar, the being sealed for ten thousand years seemed to sense the approach of Chen bloodline, slowly awakening...

text.content: The low, mournful call resonated like an ancient bell, piercing through layers of stone walls to reach the depths of the soul. Chen Ji was certain—there was something in the depths of the ruins, waiting for him. And now, the call was no longer a phantom echo, but had transformed into a scalding stream of warmth, rushing through his meridians via the Tianji Record Fragment. Wherever it passed, there was a burning sting, yet interwoven with an inexplicable sense of familiarity, as if calling a wanderer who had been separated from home for years to finally return.

Chen Ji steadied his mind and looked down at his chest—the Tianji Record Fragment was emanating a faint cyan light, that glow responding to some fluctuation from the depths of the ruins like reunited old friends conversing across the void. He took a deep breath, suppressing the surging excitement in his heart. Whatever awaited him ahead, at this moment he had to move forward. However, just then, the stone傀儡 that had been dormant behind him suddenly shuddered violently, and two points of eerie light blazed in its dust-filled eye sockets, like a fierce beast that had slumbered for ten thousand years suddenly opening its eyes.

"The bloodline has arrived. Please follow me." The傀儡's voice was hoarse and ancient, each word seeming to be squeezed out from deep within the rock layers, filled with the vicissitudes of time. It slowly turned around, mechanically walking toward the stone wall on the right, each step leaving deep footprints, accompanied by an ear-piercing grinding sound. The傀儡 raised its hand and pressed against a certain spot on the stone wall, and the entire wall rippled like water, revealing a deep and narrow passage. The inner walls of the passage were densely covered with strange runes, faintly glowing, as if guiding toward something.

dialogue.content: (Murmuring to himself) "Interesting, even an owner-recognition procedure was set up. It seems the master of these ruins truly intended to wait for someone destined... or rather, for me."

text.content: Chen Ji did not hesitate for long, stepping into the passage. As he walked, he carefully observed the stone walls on both sides. Those runes were not ordinary formation inscriptions, but an extremely ancient form of writing—more precisely, a script he had not seen in a long time, yet was carved into the depths of his bloodline. The Tianji Record Fragment in his arms trembled slightly, as if translating these ancient messages for him: "The Way of Heavenly Secrets lies in peering into Heavenly Secrets, defying the heavens..." This was the cultivation method of a prophet, and an extremely systematic and profound one at that, far beyond the scattered records on the Fragment.

He stopped walking, his fingertips gently touching the text on the stone wall. In the instant of his touch, those ancient runes actually lit up, streams of information pouring into his Mental Sea like rivulets—"Tianji Visualization Method," a systematic spiritual consciousness cultivation technique; "Heavenly Fate Divination Art," an auxiliary method for using the Tianji Record to foresee the future; "Tianji Fate-Reversal Art," a secret technique specifically designed to resist the backlash of fate... Each cultivation method was exquisite and extraordinary, any one of them sufficient to trigger a血雨腥风 in the cultivation world if spread abroad. At this moment, they were all displayed before Chen Ji without reservation, as if the master of these ruins had been determined to pass on everything to a successor.

choice.prompt: Facing such precious ancient inheritance, how should Chen Ji choose?

choices.description: Settle down and carefully study these precious cultivation methods. Even if he only comprehends one or two points, it would be immensely beneficial.
choices.visible_cost: Consume time, possibly miss some opportunities
choices.visible_reward: Gain initial comprehension of the ancient prophet's cultivation methods, Mental Sea expands
choices.risk_hint: Something might have changed in the depths of the ruins

text.content: Chen Ji sat cross-legged, his Brow Center faintly glowing. He began to study those ancient characters word by word and sentence by sentence. The Tianji Record Fragment automatically floated before him, helping him sort through the information flooding into his Mental Sea. Gradually, he caught some patterns—the core of these methods lay in the character "observe," using spiritual consciousness to observe Heavenly Secrets, reflecting the self through Heavenly Secrets, thereby achieving the realm of unity between man and heaven. Although he had only glimpsed the threshold, his Mental Sea had already expanded, and he could faintly sense the connection between the Tianji Record and these ruins becoming even closer.

choices.description: Although the inheritance is good, since something in the depths of the ruins is calling me, I should first find out what lies hidden there.
choices.visible_cost: May miss the precious information on the stone walls
choices.visible_reward: Reach the core area of the ruins earlier
choices.risk_hint: Fail to timely master key cultivation methods

text.content: Chen Ji forcefully suppressed the urge to continue studying, following the傀儡 deeper. Although the methods on the walls were precious, that inexplicable sense of calling in his heart grew stronger, as if something was eagerly waiting for him ahead. He silently memorized the text on the stone walls, deciding to carefully comprehend them after this journey ended. The passage grew narrower and narrower, and the ancient aura permeating the air became increasingly thick, until suddenly—a massive underground altar appeared before him.

choices.description: The matter of the ruins recognizing an owner is too suspicious. First observe secretly to confirm safety, then use the Tianji Record to deduce the path ahead.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain complete forward path deduction, ensuring safety

text.content: Chen Ji did not act rashly. Instead, he found a hidden corner and quietly activated the Tianji Record. As the Fragment flipped, blurry images appeared before his eyes—the altar was indeed safe, and there would be an opportunity there that could change his destiny. But at the same time, he also saw some hidden dangers: something was sealed within the depths of the altar, and that thing was awakening. Armed with this intelligence, Chen Ji's heart was greatly reassured, and he walked toward the altar.

The altar was carved from a single massive piece of blue-gray boulder, octagonal in shape, with a stone傀儡 of the same style as the entrance standing at each corner. However, these傀儡s held more reverent postures, as if saluting the center of the altar. The altar's surface was covered with intricate formation rune patterns, those patterns identical to the runes on the Tianji Record Fragment, clearly showing they originated from the same source. And right at the center of the altar, a massive "陈" character was prominently displayed, its strokes seeming to have been branded directly onto the rock through some divine power. Despite ten thousand years, it remained clear as ever, emanating a chilling pressure.

Chen Ji stared at the "陈" character, his breathing growing rapid. As a descendant of the Chen family, he understood too well what this surname meant—it was the bloodline marker of the Tianji Record's successive inheritors, the orthodox emblem of the ancient prophet lineage. Could the master of these ruins actually be an ancestor of the Chen family? He walked slowly toward the altar, and with each step closer, the Tianji Record Fragment at his chest grew more agitated, as if urging him on, yet also warning him. Until he stood at the altar's edge, that "陈" character suddenly erupted with a pillar of cyan light, instantly engulfing him.

dialogue.content: (Aged and agitated voice transmitting from the Tianji Record Fragment—Mo Xiansheng) "Chen child... you have finally arrived. Ten thousand years—this day has finally come... Here lies the tomb of the First Generation Master of the Tianji Record!"

text.content: Mo Xiansheng's words exploded in Chen Ji's mind like thunder. The First Generation Master—that was the existence bound to the Tianji Record since its very inception, the progenitor of the entire prophet lineage! Chen Ji took a deep breath. Just as he was about to ask, the cyan light on the altar suddenly transformed into a phantom figure. That figure's features were blurred, its form tall and imposing, dressed in ancient attire Chen Ji had never seen before, surrounded by dense Heavenly Secrets power. Though the features were invisible, those eyes seemed to have穿越 ten thousand years of time, gazing directly at him—carrying scrutiny, expectation, and a trace of indescribable sorrow.

dialogue.content: (Voice slightly trembling, yet trying to remain composed) "Senior... are you the First Generation Master? Is this place truly connected to this junior's bloodline?"

text.content: That phantom figure nodded slightly, then raised its hand, pointing toward the center of the altar. Chen Ji followed its guidance, and only then did he notice—beneath that massive "陈" character, there was actually a nearly invisible crack. He stepped forward and reached out to touch the crack, an icy-cold sensation transmitting through his palm. Then—"crack"—the crack slowly opened, revealing a staircase descending downward. From the depths of the staircase, faint light glimmered, accompanied by rhythmic breathing sounds, as if something slumbered, yet also as if about to awaken.

Just as Chen Ji was about to step down, hurried footsteps sounded from behind. He turned sharply, seeing Su Qingyao's figure rushing over from the depths of the passage, her breath somewhat disordered—she had clearly been hurrying all the way here. "Chen Ji!" she called out, frowning tightly, "You barged in here alone without even a word? Do you have any idea the outside has descended into chaos?" Her gaze swept across the phantom figure on the altar, her pupils contracting sharply, "This is... the residual soul of an ancient cultivator?!"

dialogue.content: (A tone with a trace of unnoticeable worry) "What exactly did you discover? The formation rune patterns on this altar... I've never seen such complex constructions. And that character—陈? What does it have to do with you?"

choice.prompt: Su Qingyao had caught up. Facing her questioning and curiosity, how should Chen Ji respond?

choices.description: Since Su Qingyao has already approached the truth multiple times, might as well take this opportunity to appropriately reveal some, testing her attitude.
choices.visible_reward: Deepen trust relationship with Su Qingyao

text.content: Chen Ji fell silent for a moment, then turned to meet Su Qingyao's eyes directly. At this moment, he decided to put away some of his disguises. "Senior Sister Su, these are the ruins of my Chen family ancestors. The Tianji Record... indeed relates to my identity." He did not say everything, but this half-truth already made Su Qingyao's breath catch. She gazed at Chen Ji's calm profile, feeling a certain taut string in her heart quietly loosen—this man who had been hiding secrets right under her nose had, for the first time, voluntarily revealed something to her.

choices.memory_label: 苏青瑶得知陈机与天机录的血脉联系

choices.description: Only reveal that this is part of the ancient ruins, continue to keep mystery about his identity.
choices.visible_cost: Su Qingyao may become even more suspicious

text.content: Chen Ji smiled faintly, that smile still harmless and innocent, "Senior Sister Su misunderstands. I also accidentally triggered some mechanism and was brought here." He paused, pointing to the phantom figure, "As for this senior... I presume it's some kind of trial mechanism of the ruins? As for that '陈' character, perhaps it's a remnant left by some great Chen cultivator, unrelated to me." Su Qingyao narrowed her eyes. She always felt something was off, but Chen Ji's expression was too calm, giving her no破绽 to seize upon.

choices.description: Take this opportunity to draw closer, the two of you proceeding into the depths of the altar together.
choices.visible_cost: Need to divided attention to protect her safety
choices.visible_reward: Gain a powerful companion, deeper exploration becomes safer

text.content: Chen Ji did not directly answer her question. Instead, he turned and lifted his chin toward the descending staircase, "Since Senior Sister Su has come all this way, why not take a look together?" His tone was relaxed, as if inviting her on a sightseeing tour, "The depths of this altar seem to hide something more. I think... it should be specifically left for the Chen family. Since you're my friend, I'd like to show you something." Su Qingyao was stunned for a moment. The word "friend" unexpectedly softened her heart, then she snorted coldly, "Save the nonsense. But since I'm here, I'll take this journey with you."

choices.memory_label: 苏青瑶与陈机结伴深入祭坛

text.content: Chen Ji observed Su Qingyao's reactions carefully, silently cataloging every microexpression. Whichever path he chose, he had already confirmed one thing—her attitude toward him, the Inner Disciple Senior Fellow, was悄然 transitioning from simple suspicion toward something more complex. This was both good and a hidden danger. But at this moment, he had no time to dwell on it, because the rhythmic breathing from the depths of the altar was becoming clearer. He exchanged a glance with Su Qingyao, and the two, one before and one behind, stepped onto the staircase leading to the altar's depths. On both sides of the staircase, every few steps was embedded a pearl emitting eerie light, illuminating this ancient corridor like a dream. The air grew increasingly cold, yet carried an inexplicable fragrance, as if some ancient flower scent穿越 ten thousand years of time and still lingered in the air.

At the end of the staircase was a massive stone door, on which was also carved a "陈" character. However, this character was even more ancient and powerful, its strokes seeming to contain some ultimate principle of the Dao. Chen Ji placed his palm on the stone door, and a slight stinging sensation transmitted through his palm—that was the burning sensation of bloodline authentication. Then, the stone door slowly slid open to both sides, and a vast and boundless aura rushed toward him. Chen Ji squinted his eyes, peering through the widening gap. Beyond the door was a massive circular stone chamber, and right at the chamber's center stood a crystal coffin of translucent clarity. And above that coffin, suspended in endless radiance—was another page of the Tianji Record Fragment!

Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. He already possessed one page of the Tianji Record Fragment, yet now another page appeared above his ancestor's coffin! Moreover, judging from the aura it emanated, this page's completeness far surpassed the one in his hands. "Two pages combined..." he murmured to himself, his voice barely concealing his excitement, "If I could merge the two pages..." Before he could finish, a low rumble suddenly sounded from the depths of the chamber.紧接着, the coffin lid of the crystal coffin began slowly moving, and a majestic, suffocating aura surged冲天 from within the coffin. Chen Ji's face changed drastically. He instinctively took a step back, shielding Su Qingyao—the existence within the coffin was seemingly awakening!

dialogue.content: (Gripping the long sword tightly, spiritual power surging) "Chen Ji, this aura... at least a Great One of the 炼虚 realm! Who is buried in this coffin?!"

text.content: Deep within the altar, the being sealed for ten thousand years seemed to sense the approach of Chen bloodline, slowly awakening...
